item.subject: science
item.stem:
Qadir's school has two overhead tanks. Tank P is tall and narrow; its water surface is 4.0 m above a ground-floor tap. Tank Q is short and wide; it holds more water in total, but its water surface is only 2.5 m above an identical ground-floor tap.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Pressure at the tap from tank P is greater because the height of water above that tap is greater.
options.B: Liquid pressure at each tap depends on the height of liquid above the tap, not on the total amount of water in the tank.
options.C: Pressure at the tap from tank Q is greater because tank Q holds more water in total.
options.D: Both taps have equal pressure because both tanks hold water.
